title: Neural Stream Chat Basic Interaction
description: Verify that the Neural Stream Chat initiates correctly and maintains context through multiple user inputs, dynamically routing queries to the correct AI models.

steps.description: Open Neural Stream Chat interface.
Input initial project ideation query.
Validate AI response is streamed and relevant to the input.
Send follow-up clarification queries.
Verify that context is preserved and AI responses adapt accordingly.
Confirm AI routing switches correctly between LLM providers based on query type.

title: Prototype Generation with React and Tailwind
description: Ensure the AI-powered prototype generation creates a working interactive React and Tailwind CSS project preview that matches the textual requirements provided by the user.

steps.description: Input detailed textual requirements for a software project.
Trigger prototype generation.
Verify live preview displays the generated React/Tailwind prototype without errors.
Check that wireframes and architecture diagrams are included and correspond to user inputs.
Interact with the live preview to confirm interactivity.
Validate interactive editing capabilities are functional.

title: Computer Use Agent Autonomous Testing with Live Video Streaming
description: Verify that the Computer Use Agent autonomously generates, executes test scenarios on the prototype, and streams the AI interactions to the user in real-time.

steps.description: Activate the Computer Use Agent for a generated prototype.
Confirm autonomous test scenarios are generated by the agent.
Observe live video streaming of AI’s interaction with the prototype.
Validate test execution results are correctly collected and displayed.
Simulate an error scenario in the prototype.
Verify the agent detects the error and reports it appropriately in the test results.

title: Real-Time Project Maturity Assessment Updates
description: Ensure that the maturity scoring engine updates project readiness indicators correctly in real-time with user input and project changes.

steps.description: Start a new project and open maturity assessment dashboard.
Make incremental changes and add details to the project in Neural Stream Chat and workspace.
Confirm maturity score updates dynamically reflecting recent inputs.
Generate prototype and run automatic tests.
Verify maturity scores adjust according to test outcomes and progress milestones.
Introduce incomplete or inconsistent data to the project.
Ensure maturity assessment indicates issues or lowers the readiness score accordingly.

title: Mission Control Dashboard Progress Visualization
description: Validate that the Mission Control dashboard properly visualizes project progress, Kanban statuses, and milestone tracking in real-time.

steps.description: Create a project with multiple milestones and tasks.
Open the Mission Control dashboard.
Verify Kanban boards display tasks with correct statuses.
Update task statuses and add new milestones.
Confirm dashboard updates task and milestone progress immediately.
Validate visualization charts accurately reflect project data from backend.

title: Collaborative Workspace Multi-User Presence and Conflict Resolution
description: Check that multiple users can simultaneously collaborate in the workspace with live cursors, presence indicators, and seamless conflict resolution.

steps.description: Two users open the same project workspace concurrently.
Verify both users see each other's cursor and user presence indicators.
User A edits a mind map node.
User B attempts to edit the same node simultaneously.
Confirm conflict resolution mechanism prevents data loss and merges or blocks edits gracefully.
Users perform concurrent multi-node edits.
Verify all changes are synchronized correctly and updates propagate in real-time.

title: Intelligent Support Widget Ticket Routing and Management
description: Test the support widget’s ability to route issues between AI and human agents and correctly manage support tickets.

steps.description: Open support widget and submit a simple query.
Verify AI agent attempts to resolve the query automatically.
Submit a complex issue that AI cannot resolve.
Confirm issue is escalated to human support agent.
Follow the ticket lifecycle: create, update, resolve.
Verify ticket updates are reflected in the widget UI correctly.

title: Admin and Governance Dashboard Compliance Data Accuracy
description: Ensure the admin dashboard displays accurate compliance, cost estimation, and system monitoring information reflecting system state.

steps.description: Log into admin dashboard with valid credentials.
Verify all compliance metrics are displayed as per backend data.
Simulate cost changes and new compliance policies.
Confirm cost estimations update and compliance status reflects the new policies in real-time.
Monitor system performance metrics.
Validate monitoring charts are updated regularly and display correct data points.

title: Authentication and Authorization Workflow
description: Verify user authentication process including signup, login with JWT issuance, and authorization flows.

steps.description: Access signup page and submit valid user details.
Confirm user account is created and appropriate confirmation message is shown.
Login with valid credentials.
Verify JWT token is issued and stored securely.
Attempt to access protected resources with and without valid token.
Ensure access is granted only with valid authentication tokens.
Attempt login with invalid credentials.
Verify login failure message is displayed and no token is issued.

title: Error Handling and Recovery in Prototype Generation
description: Test the system’s ability to handle errors gracefully during prototype generation and provide meaningful feedback to the user.

steps.description: Submit malformed or incomplete textual requirements for prototype generation.
Confirm error messages notify user about missing or incorrect inputs.
Force a backend failure scenario during prototype generation.
Verify system recovers without crashing and displays appropriate error notification.
Retry prototype generation after error.
Check successful generation and live preview after correction.
